intro: Wudu is the washing before salah. Follow the steps in order; each washing is done thoroughly. Ask your teacher about what breaks wudu and when it must be renewed.

steps.title: Make Niyyah & say Bismillah
steps.desc: Intend in your heart that this washing is for the sake of Allah, and begin with Bismillah.

steps.title: Wash the hands
steps.desc: Wash both hands up to the wrists, letting the water reach between the fingers.

steps.title: Rinse the mouth
steps.desc: Take water into the mouth and rinse it thoroughly.

steps.title: Rinse the nose
steps.desc: Sniff water gently into the nostrils and blow it out.

steps.title: Wash the face
steps.desc: Wash the whole face, from the hairline to the chin and ear to ear.

steps.title: Wash the arms
steps.desc: Wash the right arm from fingertips to above the elbow, then the left.

steps.title: Wipe the head
steps.desc: With wet hands, wipe over the head from front to back.

steps.title: Wipe the ears
steps.desc: Wipe the inside and outside of both ears with wet fingers.

steps.title: Wash the feet
steps.desc: Wash the right foot to above the ankle, then the left, between the toes too.

steps.title: Finish with the du'a
steps.desc: Complete wudu with the shahadah and the du'a taught in class — ready for salah.
